metadata.title: Blindfolded Portrait with Viscous Red Drip

recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized digital portrait of a man with dark dreadlocks and facial tattoos, wearing a translucent white blindfold. A thick, viscous red liquid drips from beneath the blindfold down his cheek and neck. The lighting is dramatic, with a strong red rim light on the left side against a stark white background.
coreVisualRelationships: The red drip acts as a vertical anchor against the horizontal blindfold.
The high-contrast white background isolates the subject's dark hair and warm skin tones.
The red rim light on the face mirrors the color of the liquid drip.
coreInvariants: Translucent texture of the blindfold showing the eyes underneath.
Viscous, glossy texture of the red liquid.
Detailed line work for dreadlocks and facial tattoos.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, cropped from the chest up, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glossy red drip is the primary focal point due to its color intensity and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical line of the red drip from the blindfold down to the neck, then moves to the facial features and hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Pure white negative space surrounds the subject, creating a clean, modern aesthetic.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks for skin and hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant crimson red for the drip and rim lighting.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red accents contrasts with the desaturated, high-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family condensed sans-serif for utilitarian metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, utilitarian feel of advisory labels.
Provides a clean, professional grotesque look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a digital painting of a man with dreadlocks and facial tattoos, wearing a white translucent blindfold. Add a thick, glossy red liquid dripping from the blindfold down his cheek. Use a pure white background and red rim lighting on the left side of his face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small, black rectangular box in the bottom-left corner containing white, bold, condensed sans-serif text stacked in three lines.

verificationChecks: Is the red drip glossy and viscous?
Is the blindfold translucent enough to see eye shapes?
Is the red rim light present on the left profile?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red rim light
mustRedesign: Specific facial tattoos to avoid intellectual property issues

mustAchieve: High contrast between subject and background
Realistic liquid physics for the drip
avoid: Soft, blurry edges on the subject silhouette

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red drip does not look like flat paint.
Check that the dreadlocks have individual strand detail.
Verify the blindfold has a visible fabric weave texture.
Confirm the text box is perfectly aligned to the bottom-left corner.
